name_cn: 山东傲饰服饰有限公司
main_products: Men's and ladies' suits, uniforms, coats, shirts
woven_evidence: Its core products are tailored suits, uniforms and coats, which are woven garments.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Tai'an city commerce bureau's booth allocation table for the 137th fair lists 山东傲饰服饰有限公司 in Phase 3, Men's & Women's Wear (男女装), with 1 standard booth.

notes: Its Made-in-China profile says Manufacturer/Factory, SGS-audited (report QIP-ASR245337) and 461 employees, but its profile text says 1,500+ workers, so the figures conflict. It claims exports to the USA, EU, Australia and Africa.
